tests.exercises: Official fixed input/output model checks for aero
tests.why: The generated official check_data exercises the candidate model API directly. Freeze the upstream input rows and expected physical model outputs outside the editable source; compare every output with per-unit bounds. The 1.17 s observation includes both module imports and both native self-checks, a conservative per-file runtime.
